product.title: Highland Lochs, Glens & Whisky Day Tour Including Admission

description.text: Travel from Edinburgh into Highland lochs and glens on a small-group whisky day with admission at Dewar's Aberfeldy Distillery. A 16-seat Mercedes mini-coach continues to Pitlochry and the River Tay, with forest, river, and waterfall photo stops toward the tasting. Stops include Dewar's Aberfeldy Distillery, Pitlochry, River Tay. Distillery timing and hotel pickup are handled so visitors can stay with a dram rather than designating a driver. Queen's View over Loch Tummel often appears as a scenic pause on the northbound run. Ideal for visitors basing in Edinburgh who want a guided whisky glen day without rural self-driving.

highlights: Explore the Scottish Highlands in a 16-seat Mercedes mini-coach
Experience the lochs, glens, and whisky of the Highlands
See Glencoe and Loch Tummel from the Queen's View
Enjoy a glass of whisky without the hassle of designating a driver
